title: GAO: DOE Is Prematurely Excluding Less Expensive Options for Nuclear Cleanup
summary: The Government Accountability Office (GAO) issued a report finding that the Department of Energy is prematurely eliminating cost-effective alternatives from consideration in nuclear cleanup projects, potentially leading to unnecessary spending of taxpayer money on more expensive solutions.
problem_solved: Addresses inefficiency and potential waste in federal nuclear cleanup procurement and decision-making processes.
why_valuable: Provides congressional oversight and transparency into how the DOE evaluates cleanup alternatives, helping ensure responsible use of billions in nuclear cleanup funding.
